bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 62
if test -f /etc/cloudflared/config.yml && grep -Eq 'hentaigay[.]org' /etc/cloudflared/config.yml; then echo HENTAGAY_INGRESS_CONFIG=YES; exit 0; fi
if test -f /etc/cloudflared/config.yaml && grep -Eq 'hentaigay[.]org' /etc/cloudflared/config.yaml; then echo HENTAGAY_INGRESS_CONFIG=YES; exit 0; fi
if test -f /home/gace/.cloudflared/config.yml && grep -Eq 'hentaigay[.]org' /home/gace/.cloudflared/config.yml; then echo HENTAGAY_INGRESS_CONFIG=YES; exit 0; fi
if test -f /home/gace/.cloudflared/config.yaml && grep -Eq 'hentaigay[.]org' /home/gace/.cloudflared/config.yaml; then echo HENTAGAY_INGRESS_CONFIG=YES; exit 0; fi
if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qi cloudflared; then echo CLOUDFLARED_DOCKER_RUNNING_BUT_NO_HENTAGAY_LOCAL_CONFIG=YES; exit 74; fi
if pgrep -x cloudflared >/dev/null; then echo CLOUDFLARED_HOST_RUNNING_BUT_NO_HENTAGAY_LOCAL_CONFIG=YES; exit 73; fi
echo HENTAGAY_INGRESS_CONFIG_AND_PROCESS=ABSENT
exit 72
